issues.explanation: rename() passes the raw new name as slug instead of a slug derived with Str::slug, so a name like 'New Name' would not yield slug 'new-name' unless the unshown action slugifies it.

grantAccess and revokeAccess resolve scoped models but do not call $this->authorize('manageAccess', $queue), relying only on SetQueueAccess for authorization instead of explicit component authorization.
Tabs use anchor href="#" with wire:click without .prevent, causing a navigation jump; a button or prevent modifier should be used.
activeTab is publicly writable so set('activeTab','evil') bypasses the allow-list in setActiveTab and renders an empty page; consider locking or validating it.
Serve render() uses raw mode for filtering without validation, so a tampered invalid mode falls through to unfiltered (any) instead of being rejected.
No test for invalid mode rejection and no per-action unauthorized test for Queues create/rename/grant by employee (only mount forbidden plus foreign-id tamper).

conventions.evidence: Uses Actions for writes, #[Validate]+validateOnly, policies via $this->authorize, {{ }} escaping and docs/CHANGELOG updates; deviates on Livewire rule 3 (grant/revoke lack $this->authorize) and rename slug not derived with Str::slug.

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:147-235 small named actions; resources/views/livewire/entity/queues.blade.php:691-705 and serve.blade.php:873-934 clear Bulma markup with aria-labels; no dead code.

requirements.evidence: Implements entity.queues/serve routes, modals, scoped findOrFail, rate-limit, tabs and lang keys per task; except Queues.php:196 slug: $this->renameName is not re-derived (Old->New should yield slug new via Str::slug).

scope.evidence: Diff only adds Queues/Serve components, views, routes, lang keys, tabs and supporting tests/docs; CHANGELOG.md:9 and docs/architecture.md:461-473 are required doc sync, no unrelated refactors.

security.evidence: Scoped findOrFail plus authorize in openQueue/startRename/rename/confirmToggle/toggleActive/openAccess and Serve callNext, #[Locked] entity/lastCalledTicketId, no unescaped output; gap is grant/revoke without explicit $this->authorize (guarded only inside action).

simplicity.evidence: Reuses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket and QueuePolicy; no service layers; queries are minimal Eloquent reads e.g. Serve.php:445-450 callableQueues.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesPageTest.php, ServePageTest.php and MembersTabsTest.php cover happy path, validation errors, 403 for employee, foreign-id tamper and rate-limit; missing invalid-mode and per-action employee tests.

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire pages, members tabs, navbar links and thorough Pest tests matching the task. Needs changes before merging: derive the rename slug with Str::slug and add explicit manageAccess authorization in grant/revoke.
